name: Bambu Lab MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive control and monitoring of Bambu Lab 3D printers through Claude using local MQTT, FTPS, and X.509 authentication. Users can manage print jobs, monitor real-time status, handle filament through AMS, and adjust hardware settings like temperature and lighting.
